name: hero-ai-infrastructure
title: Hero AI Infrastructure
description: A dark infrastructure hero washed in a deep blue glow, with slim nav, a New badge, a three-line headline, two call-to-action buttons and a partner logo wall below.
use: An AI or data platform needs a dark, confident landing hero with room for partner logos.
avoid: A full-viewport WebGL glow runs constantly, and the logo wall falls below the first screen.
a11y: The background shader never stops for reduced-motion users, and the logo mark has no text or label. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A near-black page flooded by a huge electric-blue sphere glow that fills most of the frame. A slim white nav sits at the top edge, a small pill with a blue New tag above a three-line white headline, then grey copy and two square-cornered buttons, one white and one glassy.
behaves: Elements sharpen and rise in a stagger when the section scrolls into view: nav, badge, headline, paragraph, buttons, then the partner logos. The blue glow behind drifts continuously and never settles.
customise: Copy, links and logo image URLs are inline; shader colours, camera and glow strength are literal props on the canvas.
weight: heavy: A full-screen WebGL shader runs nonstop behind the content.
demo: Headline 'Powering the Next Generation of AI Infrastructure' plus 'Trusted by 999+ growing B2B teams'.
issues: The partner logo wall never appears in the recording, which stops at the buttons.
The grey paragraph is low contrast against the bright blue wash.
polishWhy: Clean hierarchy on a strong blue glow; small grey copy is low contrast.
